decisions.reason: As a multi-model extension of the core office range, the desk system remains strategically central to flexible workplace interiors and the firm has too much design and market commitment in it to reverse course now.

The floor cushions are more niche and therefore somewhat easier to cut, but their own-page presentation, product-line breadth, and fit with the firm's broader interiors concept still favor continuation.

The high standing table is close to the established offer and aligned with contemporary office and lounge use, so prior development and positioning efforts make management more likely to retain it than abandon it.

Because the rug collection was publicly framed as a flagship direction, the visibility of that commitment strongly encourages continued backing despite its greater distance from the traditional furniture offer.
